يستعطا (form VIII)
# يَسْتَعِطَا (yastaʕiṭā) /jas.ta.ʕi.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
# يُسْتَعَطَا (yustaʕaṭā) /jus.ta.ʕa.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
